'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Casey Anis DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
